_comment: The paint booth's words (the garage's Paint button). booth.ui.choice.*: {skin} is the skin's name (its ui_skin.json's
skinname, else its folder's), {colour} the colour mixed, #RRGGBB. booth.ui.price: {cost} the job's price, {time} how
long it takes. booth.ui.spraying: {choice} what the car is painted. booth.ui.done: {cost} what it cost.
booth.colour.*: the colours of the day offered to start from, as the makers of the time might have named them.

lines.booth.ui.title: Paint Booth
lines.booth.ui.no_view: The booth cannot be shown, but the painter is here all the same.
lines.booth.ui.look_hint: Drag to walk round the car · wheel to step closer · double-click to step back
lines.booth.ui.no_car: There is no car in the garage to paint.
lines.booth.ui.no_car.title: No car
lines.booth.ui.impounded: Your car is at the police impound. Get it back before you paint it.
lines.booth.ui.impounded.title: Impounded
lines.booth.ui.body_first.rust: The painter won't spray over rust. Have it cut out first: the repair shop's wrench, under the car in the garage.
lines.booth.ui.body_first.body: The painter won't spray over dents and scratches. Have the body straightened first: the repair shop's wrench, under the car in the garage.
lines.booth.ui.body_first.both: The painter won't spray over rust, dents and scratches. Have the rust cut out and the body straightened first: the repair shop's wrench, under the car in the garage.
lines.booth.ui.body_first.title: Body work first
lines.booth.ui.none: There is no paint booth in the game: a mod took it out.
lines.booth.ui.none.title: No paint booth
lines.booth.ui.pushed_in: It won't run, so the boys pushed it into the booth.
lines.booth.ui.pick: Pick a colour: you see it on the car before he sprays it.
lines.booth.ui.tint.looking: The painter is looking at the old paint...
lines.booth.ui.tint.cannot: This paint scheme has more than one colour on it: the painter can only spray it in the make's colours.
lines.booth.ui.price: {cost} · {time}, masked, sprayed and left to dry. The old paint's wear goes with it.
lines.booth.ui.done: Done: fresh paint, {cost}. She'll dry on the way home.
